shots.title: 先管项目，再加功能
shots.narration: 上一期，我停下新功能，先收拾AI越写越乱的代码仓。这期聊聊怎么管项目。失序之钟还没做好，这套方法也在边用边改。

shots.title: 三个问题
shots.narration: 我的要求其实就三个：这次做什么，哪些地方归谁管，怎么知道做完了。项目变大后，这些信息得让下一个会话也找得到。
shots.fact_check: Primary source read at frozen SHA. First-person advice is an editorial rendering of the user framework; external enrichment is cited in source/description. No invented empirical benefit, chronology, runtime pass or user acceptance.

shots.title: 需求先行
shots.narration: 新建项目，我会先写需求文档。比如反冲跳跃，玩家想获得什么体验，这次改到哪里，怎样算完成。别一上来就让AI建一堆类。
shots.fact_check: Primary source read at frozen SHA. First-person advice is an editorial rendering of the user framework; external enrichment is cited in source/description. No invented empirical benefit, chronology, runtime pass or user acceptance.

shots.title: 把完成说清楚
shots.narration: “跳得更爽”太笼统。至少要明确，射击后怎么衔接移动，落地和受伤之后状态对不对，再录连续操作看感觉。检查通过和手感满意，得分开。
shots.fact_check: Primary source read at frozen SHA. First-person advice is an editorial rendering of the user framework; external enrichment is cited in source/description. No invented empirical benefit, chronology, runtime pass or user acceptance.

shots.title: 架构不只是文件夹
shots.narration: 接着写架构文档：用什么框架，目录怎么组织，模块怎样通信，状态由谁维护。我的游戏用Godot，按功能分模块，应用层把它们接起来。
shots.fact_check: Primary source read at frozen SHA. First-person advice is an editorial rendering of the user framework; external enrichment is cited in source/description. No invented empirical benefit, chronology, runtime pass or user acceptance.

shots.title: 谁负责执行运动
shots.narration: 拿反冲来说，输入负责表达意图，人物运动组件负责真正移动，动画和音效跟着已经接受的事件走。别让表现系统又算出另一套移动规则。
shots.fact_check: Primary source read at frozen SHA. First-person advice is an editorial rendering of the user framework; external enrichment is cited in source/description. No invented empirical benefit, chronology, runtime pass or user acceptance.

shots.title: 接上真实消费者
shots.narration: 新功能也要先找到真实调用入口。否则AI可能写出一个新的统一管理器，旧入口却照跑不误。新旧两套，喜提双倍维护。
shots.fact_check: Primary source read at frozen SHA. First-person advice is an editorial rendering of the user framework; external enrichment is cited in source/description. No invented empirical benefit, chronology, runtime pass or user acceptance.

shots.title: 模块设计
shots.narration: 然后写模块设计文档。触发条件、过程衔接，落地、受伤、暂停时怎么退出。数值引用实际配置，别在几份文档里各抄一遍。
shots.fact_check: Primary source read at frozen SHA. First-person advice is an editorial rendering of the user framework; external enrichment is cited in source/description. No invented empirical benefit, chronology, runtime pass or user acceptance.

shots.title: 小闭环迭代
shots.narration: 不用一次想完所有细节。选一个小功能，把规则、实现和真实场景打通，检查后再扩展。避免每个模块都说完成，接起来却用不了。
shots.fact_check: Primary source read at frozen SHA. First-person advice is an editorial rendering of the user framework; external enrichment is cited in source/description. No invented empirical benefit, chronology, runtime pass or user acceptance.

shots.title: AI的项目入口
shots.narration: 之后，把入口写进AGENTS文件。新会话先核对基线，看当前状态，找到任务和交接，再按模块导航读取设计与代码。入口要短，细节用链接。
shots.fact_check: Primary source read at frozen SHA. First-person advice is an editorial rendering of the user framework; external enrichment is cited in source/description. No invented empirical benefit, chronology, runtime pass or user acceptance.

shots.title: 按任务加载
shots.narration: 改人物动作，就先读人物物理、操作约束和相关代码，没必要先读完所有地区的世界观。上下文有限，得优先留给当前任务和直接依赖。
shots.fact_check: Primary source read at frozen SHA. First-person advice is an editorial rendering of the user framework; external enrichment is cited in source/description. No invented empirical benefit, chronology, runtime pass or user acceptance.

shots.title: Skills固定流程
shots.narration: 把重复流程凝结成Skills：什么情况用，先读什么，按什么顺序做，交什么证据。让经验能复用。
shots.fact_check: Primary source read at frozen SHA. First-person advice is an editorial rendering of the user framework; external enrichment is cited in source/description. No invented empirical benefit, chronology, runtime pass or user acceptance.

shots.title: 用人物Skill举例
shots.narration: 比如人物优化，先统一身体、脚底和枪口关系，再做连续动作，核对朝向、瞄准和中断恢复。当然，写在Skill里不等于AI已经做到了，还得检查结果。
shots.fact_check: Primary source read at frozen SHA. First-person advice is an editorial rendering of the user framework; external enrichment is cited in source/description. No invented empirical benefit, chronology, runtime pass or user acceptance.

shots.title: 文档当最终稿维护
shots.narration: 还有一句，我真希望最开始就加上：所有文档修改，按照最终交付件的形式更改，不进行补丁式修改和强调。改完通读全文，别只在末尾追加一句最新要求。
shots.fact_check: Primary source read at frozen SHA. First-person advice is an editorial rendering of the user framework; external enrichment is cited in source/description. No invented empirical benefit, chronology, runtime pass or user acceptance.

shots.title: 现行规则与历史分开
shots.narration: 旧规则被替代，就把正文整理成当前最终稿，相关引用也一起改。历史交给Git和PR；需要的话，另外维护简要修订记录，说明改了什么、为什么改。
shots.fact_check: Primary source read at frozen SHA. First-person advice is an editorial rendering of the user framework; external enrichment is cited in source/description. No invented empirical benefit, chronology, runtime pass or user acceptance.

shots.title: 每条规则只定义一次
shots.narration: 同一条规则只在一个地方定义。设计文档讲行为，运行配置管数值，任务表管进度，其他地方引用。到处复制、再强调，只会慢慢长出多个答案。
shots.fact_check: Primary source read at frozen SHA. First-person advice is an editorial rendering of the user framework; external enrichment is cited in source/description. No invented empirical benefit, chronology, runtime pass or user acceptance.

shots.title: 把范围圈出来
shots.narration: 每次开发，我会把任务切小：这次只改反冲衔接，写清影响范围和完成标准。不要顺手把地图、背包和成长一起重做。改动得小到能看懂，也方便撤回。
shots.fact_check: Primary source read at frozen SHA. First-person advice is an editorial rendering of the user framework; external enrichment is cited in source/description. No invented empirical benefit, chronology, runtime pass or user acceptance.

shots.title: 先对齐再动手
shots.narration: 让AI先说明准备改哪儿、怎么验证。有设计取舍就先讨论；设计变了先更新对应正文，再同步实现和配置。原规范已经正确的修复，也不用硬改文档凑流程。
shots.fact_check: Primary source read at frozen SHA. First-person advice is an editorial rendering of the user framework; external enrichment is cited in source/description. No invented empirical benefit, chronology, runtime pass or user acceptance.

shots.title: 验证按影响选择
shots.narration: 验证也按影响来。现在仓库日常CI保留四项基础检查，功能改动再选相关专项。基础检查全绿，不代表移动、存档、手机表现和手感都验过。
shots.fact_check: Primary source read at frozen SHA. First-person advice is an editorial rendering of the user framework; external enrichment is cited in source/description. No invented empirical benefit, chronology, runtime pass or user acceptance.

shots.title: 可继续的交接
shots.narration: 最后，任务表更新进度，当前交接写清基线、改了什么、实际检查、阻塞和下一步。没验就写没验。换个会话，至少能知道从哪儿继续。
shots.fact_check: Primary source read at frozen SHA. First-person advice is an editorial rendering of the user framework; external enrichment is cited in source/description. No invented empirical benefit, chronology, runtime pass or user acceptance.

shots.title: 旧方案退出
shots.narration: 旧方案退出，也不能看见legacy就全删。先查还有谁在用，接通新的消费者，验证后再清重复实现。归档可以查历史，不能继续冒充当前开发规则。
shots.fact_check: Primary source read at frozen SHA. First-person advice is an editorial rendering of the user framework; external enrichment is cited in source/description. No invented empirical benefit, chronology, runtime pass or user acceptance.

shots.title: 别越管越重
shots.narration: 管理本身也要做减法。最新整理，普通修复只要一行任务和一份交接；新地区、新怪物，按需要检查美术和玩法。别又变成填表比赛。
shots.fact_check: Primary source read at frozen SHA. First-person advice is an editorial rendering of the user framework; external enrichment is cited in source/description. No invented empirical benefit, chronology, runtime pass or user acceptance.

shots.title: 仍然没做完
shots.narration: 这些管理整理已经合入主线，但地图整合、对象设计和体验还有缺口。我现在能说的是，规则和入口更明确了；能不能长期减少返工，还得继续用。
shots.fact_check: Primary source read at frozen SHA. First-person advice is an editorial rendering of the user framework; external enrichment is cited in source/description. No invented empirical benefit, chronology, runtime pass or user acceptance.

shots.title: 串起整套方法
shots.narration: 所以我的顺序是：需求讲目标，架构划边界，设计定行为；入口负责导航，Skills固定流程，再靠小步实现、实际检查和持续更新，把它们连起来。

shots.title: 边做边改
shots.narration: 游戏还没做完，我先补项目管理。你们怎么管理AI大项目？欢迎给我支招。

bilibili_body:
上一期停工重构之后，这期聊聊我准备怎样管理越做越大的AI项目。以《失序之钟》最新主线为例：需求先讲目标与验收；架构划分目录、框架、模块职责与接口；设计落到可观察行为；AGENTS负责短入口，Skills固定可复用流程；每次小范围实现、检查和更新交接。

最想早点加的一条：文档按最终交付件维护，直接整理当前有效正文，不在末尾不断追加补丁和“再次强调”。历史和简要修订记录另外追溯。

游戏和这套方法都还没做完，没有证明能彻底消除返工。画面全部为原创动态解释图，仓库规范与个人建议分开标注；不是游戏录屏或AI真实聊天截图。AI配音，来源冻结于main 48cddb6a；PR134/135已合入，其他待办仍按实际状态判断。
